SpeakDuo / CASE STUDY

Helping conversations become learning opportunities.

Selected contributions to SpeakDuo’s language-learning experience, from conversation feedback to personal practice.

Taha Chelly · Software EngineerSoftware Engineer · Jul 2026 — Present

The learner’s challenge

A conversation gives learners plenty to reflect on. The challenge is making that reflection useful: understanding feedback, finding relevant examples, and deciding what to practice next.

AI chatbot

I developed an AI chatbot for learners, including the chat experience in the web app. It gives learners a conversational way to ask questions and explore the learning options available on the platform.

Personal practice

I used generative AI to create language-learning exercises and contributed to personalized grammar practice. Learners can revisit correction examples, save exercises, resume unfinished sessions, and review their progress.

Multilingual voice experiences

I worked on AI voice interviews and multilingual feedback features, helping learners practice speaking and review their language use. My contributions also included grammar and pronunciation feedback across supported languages.

Feedback that fits conversation

I worked on making language feedback more appropriate for spoken conversation. The aim was to distinguish everyday conversational expressions from genuine mistakes, so feedback supports learning without treating every informal phrase as an error.

My contribution

I implemented features across Python services and the React web app, connecting AI capabilities to usable learning tools. My work covered development, review feedback, and checks of the learner experience.

What this work represents

The work connects conversation review with follow-up practice. It reflects my approach to product development: understand the learner’s need, contribute within a team, and check that the resulting experience makes sense.
